/* 구포털 기획(gihoek/index.html)의 정산서(대금청구서·지급예정서) 양식 원본 — settleDocHTML·SET_DOC_CSS·pvPrint. 새 영업기획의 정산서 양식이 같은 결과를 내는지 대조하는 기준(2026-10-13). 수정하지 않는다. 2026-10-13 갱신: 본섭 정산서 특이사항 추가(gihoek 20261013a, 본섭 커밋 f4bc259)를 반영한 원본. */
function settleDocHTML(s){ const title=s.docType==='invoice'?'대 금 청 구 서':'지 급 예 정 서';
  const dateLabel=s.docType==='invoice'?'지급요청일':'지급예정일'; const sd=s.sender||{}, rc=s.recipient||{}; const p=projects.find(x=>x.id===s.pjtId);
  const pjtLabel=(s.pjtIds&&s.pjtIds.length>1)? s.pjtIds.map(pid=>{const pp=projects.find(x=>x.id===pid);return pp?pp.code:pid;}).join(' + ') : (p?p.code:'-');
  const rows=(s.lines||[]).map((it,i)=>`<tr><td style="text-align:center">${i+1}</td><td>${it.name}</td><td>${it.spec||''}</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(it.amount)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  return `<h1>${title}</h1>
  <div class="meta"><span>발행번호: ${s.no}</span><span>발행일: ${s.issueDate}</span></div>
  <div class="parties">
    <div class="pcard"><div class="h">${s.docType==='invoice'?'수신 (원청)':'수신 (하청)'}</div><div class="nm">${rc.company||'-'}</div><div class="ln">${rc.ceo?'대표 '+rc.ceo:''}${rc.bizno?' / '+rc.bizno:''}</div>${rc.contact?`<div class="ln">${rc.contactTel?rc.contactTel+' ':''}(${rc.contact})</div>`:(rc.tel?`<div class="ln">${rc.tel}</div>`:'')}</div>
    <div class="pcard"><div class="h">발신 (공급자)</div><div class="nm">${sd.company||'-'}</div><div class="ln">${sd.ceo?'대표 '+sd.ceo:''}${sd.bizno?' / '+sd.bizno:''}</div>${sd.tel?`<div class="ln">${sd.tel}</div>`:''}</div></div>
  <div class="info"><b>프로젝트</b> : ${pjtLabel} &nbsp;&nbsp; <b>기준월</b> : ${s.baseMonth} &nbsp;&nbsp; <b>${dateLabel}</b> : ${s.payDate||'-'}</div>
  <table><thead><tr><th style="width:34px">No</th><th>내역</th><th>비고</th><th style="width:130px">금액</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody>
  <tfoot><tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:right">공급가액</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(s.supply)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:right">부가세 (10%)</td><td style="text-align:right">${won(s.vat)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:right;font-size:14px">${s.docType==='invoice'?'청구금액 합계':'지급금액 합계'}</td><td style="text-align:right;font-size:14px">${won(s.total)}</td></tr></tfoot></table>
  ${s.notes?`<div style="margin-top:14px;border:1px solid #cfd8e6;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:#1D5BA6;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;letter-spacing:1px">특이사항</div><div style="font-size:11.5px;white-space:pre-wrap">${s.notes.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')}</div></div>`:''}
  <div class="stamp">위와 같이 ${s.docType==='invoice'?'청구':'지급 예정 통보'}합니다.<br><br>${sd.company||''}　${sd.ceo?'대표 '+sd.ceo+' (인)':''} ${sd.contact?'<br><span style="font-size:11px;color:#555">담당: '+sd.contact+(sd.contactTel?' &nbsp;'+sd.contactTel:'')+(sd.contactEmail?' &nbsp;'+sd.contactEmail:'')+'</span>':''}</div>`;
}
const SET_DOC_CSS=`*{box-sizing:border-box;font-family:'Malgun Gothic',sans-serif}body{margin:0;color:#1a2330;font-size:12px}
  h1{text-align:center;font-size:25px;letter-spacing:10px;margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:800}
  .meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:#555;margin-bottom:10px}
  .parties{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}.pcard{flex:1;border:1px solid #cfd8e6;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px}
  .pcard .h{font-size:10px;color:#1D5BA6;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px}.pcard .nm{font-size:14px;font-weight:800}.pcard .ln{font-size:11px;color:#444;margin-top:2px}
  .info{border:1px solid #cfd8e6;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.9}
  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:4px}th,td{border:1px solid #cfd8e6;padding:7px 8px;font-size:11.5px}
  th{background:#eaf2fc;color:#1D5BA6}tfoot td{font-weight:700;background:#f6f9fd}.stamp{margin-top:22px;text-align:right;font-size:12px}`;
window.previewSettle=function(id){ const s=settlements.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!s) return;
  $('pv-body').innerHTML=`<div class="setdoc">${settleDocHTML(s)}</div>`; $('pv').dataset.sid=id; $('pv').style.display='flex'; document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; };
window.pvClose=function(){ $('pv').style.display='none'; document.body.style.overflow=''; };
window.pvPrint=function(){ const s=settlements.find(x=>x.id===$('pv').dataset.sid); if(!s) return;
  const w=window.open('','_blank'); if(!w){ toast('팝업이 차단되었습니다.'); return; }
  w.document.write(`<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${s.docType==='invoice'?'대금청구서':'지급예정서'} ${s.no}</title><style>@page{size:A4;margin:16mm}${SET_DOC_CSS}</style>${settleDocHTML(s)}<scr`+`ipt>window.onload=function(){setTimeout(function(){window.print();},250);}</scr`+`ipt>`);
  w.document.close(); };
